headline: 美國文化戰紀錄片開播
context: 奧斯卡得主導演巴瑞李文森（Barry Levinson）推出紀錄片《Bucks County, USA》，聚焦一座小鎮裡的政治對立。片中透過一對青少女好友的家庭，呈現美國社會左右兩端的裂痕。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Oscar-winning film-maker Barry Levinson’s docuseries Bucks County, USA examines the political divide in one town in a revealing and infuriating manner Like many teenage best friends, Evi and Vanessa have a penchant for finishing each other’s sentences. Whether enmeshed on a couch or telling a story, one, a red-headed musical theater nerd with a personality nearly as boisterous as her signature puffy skirts, collides with the other, darker in hair and disposition, their speech bubbling with indecipherable affirmations and giggles. In a heady chorus of “duuude” and “no, you!”, it can be difficult to tell where one girl ends and the other begins. Except, that is, at their respective homes. Evi’s mother, Lela, who like her daughter, espouses views considered left of liberal in the US context, speaks in support of LGBTQ students at local school board meetings and advocates for fact-based history lessons. Vanessa’s father, Paul Martino, is a right-leaning venture capitalist who likes to brag about installing school board members by spending $500,000 on local campaigns, an effort triggered by what he saw as unjustified school closures in the wake of the Covid-19 pandemic. thread_text:
奧斯卡得主導演巴瑞李文森（Barry Levinson），推出新紀錄片《Bucks County, USA》，聚焦美國賓州一座小鎮裡的政治對立。片中主角是一對形影不離的青少女好友——伊薇（Evi）跟凡妮莎（Vanessa）。伊薇的媽媽萊拉（Lela）立場偏左，在校務會議上為 LGBTQ 學生發聲，主張教歷史要忠於事實；凡妮莎的爸爸保羅馬蒂諾（Paul Martino）則是立場偏右的創投業者，曾砸下 50 萬美元介入地方校務委員選舉，起因是他不滿疫情期間學校停課的決定。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 9 月 22 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 有一部新紀錄片，直接把鏡頭對準美國的政治對立。導演是奧斯卡得主巴瑞李文森，片名叫《Bucks County, USA》，拍的是賓州一座小鎮。片中主角，是一對形影不離的青少女好友，伊薇跟凡妮莎。伊薇的媽媽萊拉，立場偏左，會在校務會議上為 LGBTQ 學生發聲；凡妮莎的爸爸保羅馬蒂諾，立場偏右，是一位創投業者，曾經砸下 50 萬美元介入地方校務委員選舉——起因是他不滿疫情期間學校停課的決定。
